product_summary: Website chemikleen.com (homepage, fetched) lists the real product lines: Toothpastes; Aggarbatti; Creams & Lotion; Detergents & Cleaners; Glucose Powder; Hair Oil; Eagle Naphthalene Balls; Shampoo; Spray Perfume; Shaving Cream; Soap; Talcum Powder. Text states the company was established 1972, has a unit in Naraina Industrial Area, New Delhi and another in Bahadurgarh (Haryana), and manufactures the full range of toiletries and cleaning preparations: detergent powder and cakes of various grades, glass & household cleaner, toilet cleaner, multi-utility cleaner, floor cleaner, dish wash liquid, bar & gel, scouring powder, descalent powder for washing machines, liquid hand wash, laundry liquid. It also states it is an approved vendor to Wal-Mart and Carrefour for cleaning preparations (Ultra-Marine Blue Liquid & Powder, detergents in 'Tide grade / Surf Excel grade / Rin grade / Wheel grade', detergent powder, naphthalene balls, coconut oil). All of the above is website self-declaration only - no customs line or invoice was reviewed in this task, so every code is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
role_hint: manufacturer (two own units: Naraina, New Delhi + Bahadurgarh, Haryana; own brand 'Eagle' for naphthalene balls). Trader signs: none found on the site - no 'we are a trading house / sourcing agent' language, no third-party brand resale claims beyond the Wal-Mart/Carrefour vendor relationship, which is a supply contract, not trading.
comment: HS mapping vs declared 330290; 330300; 330610; 340242. (1) 330610 toothpaste - EXACT, corroborated by the site's 'Toothpastes' line. (2) 330300 perfumes/toilet waters - PARTIAL: site lists 'Spray Perfume', which fits 330300, but the bulk of the perfumery range (agarbatti, talcum, creams) sits in other 3307/3304 headings. (3) 330290 'mixtures of odoriferous substances' - WRONG/over-broad: 330290 is the industrial fragrance-compound heading (raw material for perfumery), while the site describes finished consumer goods (agarbatti, spray perfume, talc). Finished agarbatti is 330741, room deodorising 330749, other perfumery 330790. No evidence of fragrance-compound manufacture or sale was found on the site. (4) 340242 'non-ionic surface-active agents' - WRONG: 340242 is a bulk organic-surfactant raw-material heading. The site's detergents and cleaners are retail/finished preparations, which belong in 340111/340119 (soap and washing preparations incl. cakes/bars) and 340220/340290 (surface-active preparations, retail vs bulk). No evidence of surfactant raw-material supply. (5) MISSING from the declaration: the largest part of the range - detergents, dish wash, floor/toilet/glass cleaners, scouring powder, descalent, liquid hand wash, laundry liquid (3401/3402), soap (340111), shaving cream (330710), creams & lotions (330499), hair oil and shampoo (330590), talcum (330491), agarbatti (330741), naphthalene balls (moth repellent - 290290 naphthalene or 271290 if wax-based; the site does not state the base, so cannot_verify), glucose powder (170230/170240 - food, outside the declared cosmetic/detergent scope entirely), coconut oil (151319). (6) Industry misclassification: declared industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is too narrow/misleading - this is a cosmetics, toiletries and household-cleaning FMCG manufacturer, not an oil & gas or petrochemical supplier. The 340242 code is probably what pulled it into the 'chemicals' bucket. (7) Verdict per Rule 3: HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground - company is retained, codes corrected to the actual FMCG range above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. (8) Factuality caveat per Rule 5: the product list is the company's own website claim; no customs line, GST turnover or purchase order was examined here, so export and domestic supply activity is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - the Wal-Mart/Carrefour 'approved vendor' statement in particular is an unverified self-claim. (9) Note: the site is a 2011 copyright and several sub-pages (products/about) return 404, so the catalogue could not be read in depth; the product list above comes from the homepage navigation and body text only. Search engine was unavailable during this check, so no independent catalogue (IndiaMART etc.) could be cross-read - IndiaMART returned HTTP 429.
